summary: Frontend visual regression + functional smoke after Swiss High-Contrast light-theme redesign. Tested as Admin, Client (Priya), Vendor (Vikram), Accountant (Asha), Site Engineer (Raj). All 11 admin pages, client dashboard/projects/field-ops, vendor bid-packages, and accountant finance/payroll load cleanly in the new light theme. Sidebar is dark slate-900 with amber BUILDCORE logo (intentional contrast) and blue active-item border. Charts render with new blue/amber/emerald palette. Status badges are rounded-full pastels. New Project modal opens with dark text (rgb 15,23,41) on white/near-white inputs (all readable). Notification bell popover opens. No white-on-white / dark-on-dark leaves found on any page via programmatic contrast scan. Zero API 500s during navigation.

issues: Minor: percentage labels (52%, 10%) inside light-purple Metro Depot Gantt bar are white text on light lilac — borderline low contrast. Legible but not WCAG-AA. Consider darker fill or dark text for lighter bar colors.
Console: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning, not visual).

Recharts console warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' fires briefly on first render — cosmetic, charts still render correctly. Consider setting minHeight on ResponsiveContainer parent.

action_items: Optional: bump contrast of Gantt-bar percentage labels on lighter fills (lilac/light-amber) — either darken bar or switch label to slate-900.
Optional: add Description or aria-describedby to Radix DialogContent in New Project / New Phase modals (a11y).
Optional: give Recharts ResponsiveContainer a minHeight to silence the -1 width/height warnings on first paint.
critical_code_review_comments: Redesign was applied via class-mapping only — data-testids preserved; no functional regressions detected across 5 role sessions.
Consider replacing generic native <select> (bg rgb(239,239,239)) in New Project modal with shadcn Select for consistency with the rest of the white-input styling.
test_credentials: Used from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all 5 role logins succeeded (admin/client/vendor/accountant/site-engineer).
seed_data_creation: None. No test data created; skipped destructive Create/Delete project flow because backend testing was explicitly out of scope and to keep DB clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesign is visually clean across all portals. Only cosmetic tweaks remain (Gantt label contrast on lighter fills, Radix Dialog a11y description, Recharts minHeight warning). Non-admin roles (client/vendor/accountant/site-engineer) after login land on /admin URL but the sidebar correctly filters nav items by role, so routing works. If deeper functional testing needed later: New Project create+delete flow, one-tap attendance on Field Ops (button not visible on SE landing — may require navigating to a specific project or field-ops page).
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Programmatic contrast scan flagged 5 leaves per admin dashboard load, but manual screenshot review confirms all are white percentage labels rendered inside colored Gantt fill bars; the DOM has a slate-200 track wrapper that the walker resolved as background — a scanner false positive, not a real UI defect.
